Subject: Meeting space technical readiness + travel sync — Northstar Executive Workshop

Hi all,

We need to lock the technical and travel plan for the Northstar executive workshop on Nov 30–Dec 1 (18 attendees, 4 execs traveling from SF). High-level asks below — want to confirm timelines and owners so the venue and travel vendor can action.

Event footprint: main boardroom (18 pax, U-shaped), two nearby breakout rooms (8 pax each), and a small phone booth for private 1:1s. Blocked rooms at Rowan Hotel (walking distance) for execs.

Technical requirements (must-have):
- Zoom Room-capable boardroom with a native SIP/Zoom connector + Poly bridge fallback
- Primary 4K pan-tilt-zoom camera + ceiling mic array (room coverage for 4 speakers)
- Two HDMI lines to dais, one wireless presentation (Barco ClickShare or similar)
- Dedicated wired ethernet (1 Gbps) for primary AV rack, 500 Mbps dedicated to the meeting during event hours; LTE failover
- Local onsite AV tech from 07:30 to 18:30 each day; day-of recording to MP4 and optional livestream to private S3 bucket
- HDMI/USB-C adapters and two loaner Windows laptops (for stage/test purposes)

Operational asks:
- Onsite test run on Nov 30 at 08:30 (all Redwood laptops + Northstar laptop).
- Quiet room for recorded 1:1s; we need a simple sound-treated option.
- Badging and door access for 18 Redwood/Northstar badges starting 06:45 on Nov 30.

Travel/logistics:
- Evelyn: can you confirm pick-ups from LGA for the four execs and the room block cutoff?
- Jonas: can you own final attendee list and dietary needs?

Brian/Sara: please confirm venue can meet the technical requirements above and provide a short runbook for day-of (AV contact, bandwidth SLA, test times). I attached room_layout_v3.pdf and initial_av_rider.pdf for reference.

Thanks — Laura

--
Laura Bennett

Subject: Re: Meeting space technical readiness + travel sync — Northstar Executive Workshop

Laura — thanks for the clear list. A few questions and notes from the ops side:

1) Room capacity and microphone layout: the room_layout_v3 shows two ceiling mic pods; for an 18-person U-shape we should request a minimum of 4 cardioid tabletop mics to avoid gaps when attendees move.
2) Recording requirements: confirm whether we need separate multitrack audio (for transcribe quality) or a single stereo mix. Multitrack will need a local recorder on the AV rack.
3) Bandwidth SLA: can the venue commit to a 95% uptime SLA for the dedicated 500 Mbps during 07:00–19:00? If not, we should plan for a bonded cellular backup.
4) Travel: I'll join the 08:30 test run. Recommend we do a full dry-run with speakers and remote participant dial-in at 09:00 on Nov 30.

If Brian can confirm mic counts and the SLA we can finalize the AV quote.

- Markus
VP, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Meeting space technical readiness + travel sync — Northstar Executive Workshop

Hi Laura/Markus/Sara —

Thanks for the detailed requirements. Confirmations below and notes on pricing:

1) AV equipment & tech: we can provide a Zoom Room-ready install with Poly bridge fallback; we'll bring a 4K PTZ camera, a Shure MXA910 ceiling array, and 4 Shure MXA310 tabletop mics as a conservative baseline. Onsite tech: Alex Rivera (cc'd) will be assigned 07:00–19:00 each day.
2) Recording: we can capture multitrack (separate channels for dais mics) with a local recorder; we'll provide exported WAVs and a stereo MP4 for Redwood.
3) Network: we will provision a dedicated 500 Mbps fiber for the AV rack with a Level 1 SLA (98% uptime during event hours). Cellular LTE failover available at 200 Mbps aggregated. For strict 99.9% SLA we can arrange a bonded secondary carrier for an extra fee — see attached venue_wifi_specsheet.pdf and venue_av_quote.pdf.
4) Adapters/loaner laptops: we can provide 2 Windows loaner laptops and a kit of adapters (HDMI, DisplayPort, USB-C) in the AV rack.

Pricing note: the multitrack recorder + bonded carrier option adds approx $1,250 to the AV package. Venue contract redlines we received are in DocuSign — happy to set a call if needed.

Alex — can you confirm you'll be onsite and able to run a full dry-run at 08:30 on Nov 30? Also list any special staging requests.

Best,

Subject: Final operational plan + day-of AV test script — Northstar Executive Workshop (Nov 30)

Team — thanks for the confirmations. Final checklist and day-of script below. Please review and flag any open items by EOD Nov 23.

Day-of run order (Nov 30)
07:00 — AV rack power and network validation (Alex)
07:30 — Badge table setup and badging team in lobby (Brian)
08:00 — Loaner laptops staged and adapters checked (Brian/Alex)
08:30 — Full AV dry-run: host laptops (Redwood & Northstar), remote dial-in, recording validation, livestream to S3 (Markus + Alex + Laura)
09:00 — Speaker prep / mic check (speakers on dais)
09:30 — Doors open; welcome coffee

AV test script (high level — see dayof_av_test_script.txt attached):
- Confirm Zoom Room connects to corporate account and Poly bridge fallback works (dial test to +1-650-555-0199)
- Swap to backup laptop and verify screen share latency < 150ms for HD content
- Simulate carrier failover: unplug fiber, verify LTE bond maintains audio/video for 5 minutes
- Start multitrack recording, confirm separate channel exports format and file transfer to S3 after event

Open items:
- Venue to confirm bonded carrier add-on if we decide to buy (Brian/Markus)
- Final list of speaker slides for pre-load to loaner laptops (Jonas: collect by Nov 25)
- Badge list from Evelyn to Brian by Nov 28 for early check-in

Attachments: final_room_diagram.pdf, dayof_av_test_script.txt (linked in Drive).

If there are no objections, we'll proceed with the multitrack recorder + bonded carrier option and sign the DocuSign venue amendment.

Thanks everyone — see you on the 30th.
